support.hours: 8 am to 6 pm AEST, Monday to Friday

requirements.needs: The Fieldbook app, on a device released in the last six years, with a camera and location turned on.
A current desktop browser, at least 1280 pixels wide. Web inspections can attach photos but not take them.
An invitation from your workspace administrator. Fieldbook has no self sign-up.
About 1 GB free on the device for two weeks of offline work with photos.

troubleshooting.problem: Sign-in says the invitation has expired
troubleshooting.fix: Ask your administrator to send a new one from Workspace › People.

troubleshooting.problem: An assignment is missing from Today
troubleshooting.cause: It belongs to another workspace, or its start date is in the future.
troubleshooting.fix: Switch workspace from the menu, or look under Upcoming.

troubleshooting.cause: A required question has no answer, or a finding has no photo.
troubleshooting.fix: Tap the red count beside Sign off to jump to what is missing.

troubleshooting.cause: The device is on mobile data and Photos on Wi-Fi only is on.
troubleshooting.fix: Join Wi-Fi, or turn the setting off under Settings › Sync.

troubleshooting.problem: The sync badge shows a conflict
troubleshooting.cause: Someone changed the same inspection on the web while you were offline.
troubleshooting.fix: Open it and choose Keep mine or Keep theirs for each answer.

troubleshooting.problem: The map pin is in the wrong place
troubleshooting.cause: The device had no location fix when the photo was taken.
troubleshooting.fix: Drag the pin on the finding, or turn on precise location for Fieldbook.

glossary.definition: An inspection someone has been asked to do, with a site, a checklist and a due date.
The questions an inspection asks, in sections. Administrators build them from templates.
Two changes to the same answer made on different devices before either synced.
The day an assignment should be signed off by. Overdue assignments turn red in Today.
Something the inspector noticed that needs action, with a rating, photos and a note.
A question that stops the inspection until a supervisor approves it on their own device.
One visit to one site, from the first answer to the sign-off.
Arrows, circles and short labels drawn on a photo. The original photo is kept.
Changes and photos saved on the device and waiting to sync.
How serious a finding is: low, medium, high or critical.
Unlocking a signed-off inspection to correct it. Only a supervisor can, and the history keeps both versions.
The inspector's signature, name and time, which locks the inspection and sends the report.
A place that is inspected, such as a building, a plant room or a stretch of road, with its address and map pin.
Sending the offline queue to Fieldbook's servers and fetching new assignments.
A reusable checklist, versioned so that past inspections keep the questions they were asked.
An organisation's own space in Fieldbook: its people, sites, templates and reports.
